note: Components quoted from each venue's own PDF. Amounts that were not on the page are omitted. A conflicting pair of percents is stored as a range and flagged for review.

fnbMinimum.quote: Saturday: 18,000 food and beverage minimum. Food and beverage minimums do not include tax (7.25%) or service charge (23%).
fnbMinimum.note: Saturday food-and-beverage minimum from the 2027 wedding guide. It replaces the study food line. Friday and Sunday minimums are lower and are the off-day range.

serviceCharge.quote: A 23% service charge. Package pricing is determined by entrée selection, plus 7.25% tax and 23% service charge.
serviceCharge.note: 23% service charge on food and beverage. It is not applied to the site-fee range. It is not a tip.

tax.quote: Food and beverage minimums do not include tax (7.25%) or service charge (23%).
tax.note: 7.25% from the wedding guide, applied to the food-and-beverage minimum. The guide does not say this percent is also charged on the service charge or on the site fee, so those are not taxed here. Wheaton is not the City of Chicago rate.

el-chorro.siteFeeNote: The Saturday figure on the price list is a food-and-beverage minimum, not a site rental.
el-chorro.review: The PDF states both a 28% taxable service charge and a 27% taxable service charge. The total uses that range. A person should confirm which percent is on the current contract.

fnbMinimum.quote: Evening Reception: $175++ per person. The higher of the food-and-beverage minimum and the per-person minimum applies.
fnbMinimum.note: Saturday food-and-beverage minimum is the catalog floor of $50,000, and the evening per-person minimum is $175. The total uses whichever is higher. ++ means service and tax are extra.

serviceCharge.quote: PRICE DOES NOT INCLUDE 8.8% SALES TAX AND 28% TAXABLE SERVICE CHARGE. A 27% taxable service charge and current state sales tax will be added to all food and beverage.
serviceCharge.note: The same PDF prints 28% and 27%. Both are shown. The charge is taxable. It is not a tip.

tax.quote: 8.8% SALES TAX AND 28% TAXABLE SERVICE CHARGE. Ceremony Fees and Meeting Room Rental are subject to a 8.8% State Sales Tax.
tax.note: 8.8% from the venue PDF, applied to food, the service charge, and the ceremony fee.
tax.review: The PDF calls 8.8% the state sales tax. Confirm it against the Arizona TPT rate for Paradise Valley before treating it as the only tax.

addOns.label: Ceremony fee
addOns.note: Event Lawn ceremony fee. Saturday is $7,000. The Sunday–Friday fee is lower and is not used on the Saturday total.

royal-palms.siteFeeNote: Hosted wedding packages are priced per person and include dinner and a hosted bar.

perPerson.label: Hosted package, per person
perPerson.quote: $255 per person, $275 per person, and $310 per person.
perPerson.note: Three hosted packages from the 2026–2027 wedding PDF. They include dinner and a hosted bar. Food-and-beverage charges are before the service charge and the administrative fee.

serviceCharge.quote: The food & beverage charges are each subject to and exclusive of a separate mandatory service charge of 17.6%, which will be distributed to the service staff.
serviceCharge.note: 17.6% service charge on the food-and-beverage package. The PDF says it is distributed to banquet staff. It is separate from the 8.4% administrative fee.

addOns.label: Administrative fee 8.4%
addOns.quote: The food & beverage charges are also subject to and exclusive of a separate mandatory charge of 8.4%, which will be retained by the hotel as an administrative fee.
addOns.note: 8.4% administrative fee on the food-and-beverage package. The PDF says it is not a tip.

salish-lodge.review: Snoqualmie is outside the Seattle sales-tax location. The PDF says pricing is subject to tax and does not print a percent, so tax is still missing.

peak.quote: Saturdays, May 1–October 31, Cliffside Ballroom facility rental $6,000. Friday evening facility rental $5,500.
peak.note: Peak-season Cliffside facility rental. The food minimum is separate.

off.quote: Saturdays, November 1–April 30, Cliffside Ballroom facility rental $4,000.

fnbMinimum.quote: Saturdays, May 1–October 31, food and beverage minimum $10,000. November 1–April 30, food and beverage minimum $7,000.
fnbMinimum.note: Cliffside Saturday food-and-beverage minimum. It replaces the study food line.

serviceCharge.quote: Pricing is subject to a 24% service charge.
serviceCharge.note: 24% service charge from the pricing chart, applied to the food minimum. The chart also says all pricing is subject to tax, without a percent.

peak.quote: Saturday peak season, May 22–October 12, nine-hour rental $15,000. Monday–Thursday peak $6,000.
peak.note: Peak Saturday rental for the Hunnewell Building or Maple Grove.

addOns.label: Administrative fee 5%
addOns.quote: A 5% administrative fee is applied for all events.
addOns.note: 5% of the site rental. The rate sheet does not call this a sales tax.

addOns.label: Ceremony fee
addOns.quote: Ceremony Fee $1,500 in peak season and $1,250 in the shoulder season, including white garden chairs for up to 230 guests.
addOns.note: On-site ceremony fee from the 2026 rate sheet.

addOns.label: Wedding administrative fee
addOns.quote: There is an additional $250 administrative fee for all weddings.
addOns.note: Flat fee for weddings. It is not a sales tax.

tax.quote: Prices below do not include applicable sales tax of 8.25%.
tax.note: 8.25% is printed on the drink prices in the 2026 brochure, not on the room rental. It is applied to the food estimate only.

tax.quote: Prices below do not include applicable sales tax of 8.25%.

brooklyn-botanic-palm-house.review: Room rental and the food minimum are Palm House only. The Atrium on the same kit is a smaller room and is not mixed into this total. The 26% administrative fee is applied to the food line because the kit says the food minimum is before that fee. It does not say the percent also applies to the room rental, so the rental is not marked up. Off-day food uses the May–October Sunday minimum. Other Sunday minimums are lower and stay in the note.

peak.quote: Palm House room rental, May, Jun, Sep, Oct: Saturday $12,000. Sunday $6,000. Friday $6,800.
peak.note: Palm House peak Saturday room rental from Union Square Events' 2027 wedding kit, the garden's exclusive caterer. Sunday in those months is $6,000. Friday is $6,800 and is not this off-day figure. The garden's own weddings page does not print these fees.

off.quote: Palm House Saturday room rental is $8,500 in Mar, Apr, Nov and $7,500 in Jul, Aug and Dec, Jan, Feb. Sunday is $5,000 in Mar, Apr, Nov and $4,500 in the other off-peak months.
off.note: Palm House Saturday room rental outside May, June, September, and October. The low figure is July–August and December–February. The high figure is March, April, and November.

fnbMinimum.quote: Palm House Saturday food and beverage minimum, May–June and Sep–Oct: $55,000. Event package breakdown starting at $228 per person. Before room rental, membership fee, 26% administrative fee, and tax.
fnbMinimum.note: Union Square Events' Palm House food-and-beverage minimum for a peak Saturday, or $228 a person when that is higher. The $228 package is their published starting menu: cocktail hour, a seated dinner, wedding cake, and a four-hour open bar. It replaces the study food line. It is not a quote from the garden's own page.

serviceCharge.quote: Before Room Rental, Membership Fee, 26% Administrative Fee and Tax.
serviceCharge.note: 26% administrative fee from the exclusive caterer's kit, applied to the food line. It is not a tip. The kit does not say this percent is also charged on the room rental.

addOns.label: Wedding day fee
addOns.quote: WEDDING DAY FEE: $4,000. (1) VIP Server for up to 9 hours. Setup and breakdown of ceremony with white folding chairs. Coat check and restroom attendants.
addOns.note: Required wedding-day fee on the Palm House page of the same kit. It is separate from the room rental.

addOns.label: Patron membership
addOns.quote: Patron Membership Fee: $800 ($677 tax deductible); Only Patron-level members may host events on BBG premises.
addOns.note: The kit says only Patron-level members may host. The charge is $800. The kit says $677 of that is tax deductible. The deductible portion is not subtracted here.

addOns.label: Overtime
addOns.quote: Additional event hours may be purchased at the standard overtime rate of $500.00.
addOns.note: Published hourly overtime. It is not added until a couple is past the included hours.
